# Pollinations Field Guide

Pollinations is an open-source AI generation ecosystem providing unified text, image, audio, and video inference across official and community-hosted models.

This wiki serves as an architectural index and reference guide for developers building on or extending the platform.

### Quick Links
- **API Dashboard & Keys**: [enter.pollinations.ai](https://enter.pollinations.ai)
- **Live Gateway & Docs**: [gen.pollinations.ai](https://gen.pollinations.ai)
- **Official Discord**: [discord.gg/pollinations](https://discord.gg/pollinations)

### Wiki Directory
1. [[Architecture & Services|Architecture-and-Services]] - Request lifecycle, repo layout, and core services.
2. [[Quick Integration|Quick-Integration]] - Minimal primitives for HTTP and SDK integrations.
3. [[Tiers & Ecosystem Extensions|Tiers-and-Community-Models]] - Dev points, tiers, BYOM, and BYOP.
4. [[Troubleshooting & FAQs|Troubleshooting]] - Rate limits, fallback handling, and support triage.
